findings.title: Audit log list and export are not org-scoped by default
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/audit.ts:24-50 applies requireOrgAccess+requireAdmin, applyRequestedOrg and applyOrgScope (mandatory org predicate) to list and export; lib/admin-scope.ts:70-140 fails closed for non-cross-tenant admins. The multi-org membership variant is tracked separately as MT-P1-005.

findings.title: Platform dashboards expose all-tenant aggregates to any single-org admin
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/dashboard.ts:16-50 and business-os.ts:35-62 scope every aggregate with resolveAdminTenantScope + applyOrgScope; single-org admins see only their resolved org list. The multi-org membership variant is tracked as MT-P1-005.

findings.title: Public file-request upload authorizes with a permission unioned across all orgs
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/file-requests.ts:114-160 authorizes on the request token row and binds every write to data.organization_id (:161,197-275); the claim RPC is org-bound.

findings.title: Response cache keys omit the caller's tenant scope, so all-tenant responses can be served to single-org members
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: middleware/cache.ts:204-260 folds a scopeFingerprint (allTenants + sorted orgIds hash) into the key, and documents list now opts into userScoped at routes/documents.ts:227; scope-dependent routes pass resolveAdminTenantScope.

findings.title: Admin global search lists all organizations and can fall through unscoped
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/search.ts:78-260 resolves canSeeAllTenants/requestedOrg, applies scopedOrgIds to users/tickets/projects/documents/organizations, and only unscopes for genuine super-admin cross-tenant callers; search-tenant-scope.test.ts + search-org-pin.test.ts cover it.

findings.title: By-id org filters are conditional, so they fail open if the org gate is not reached
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: the mandatory applyResolvedOrg helper (lib/admin-scope.ts:141-165, throws 403 when no scope resolves) is used in findings/tickets/qbr/documents and notifications list, and the tenant-scoping-guard allowlist no longer lists findings/tickets/qbr. Residual unchanged: conditional `if (orgId)` filters remain in ai.ts:329,546, api-keys.ts:53, approvals.ts:101,132,174, assets.ts:84,113,148, documents.ts:413,434,540,578,616,626,655, and others; they are safe only because requireOrgAccess injects organization_id for non-platform admins.

findings.title: Storage writer path and RLS org-derivation disagree (`orgs/<uuid>/` vs `<uuid>/`)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: storage writers prefix objects with the org UUID - documents.ts:387 `${organizationId}/...`, file-requests.ts:161 `${data.organization_id}/requests/...`; storage_path_org_id (5302026:799-825) parses that UUID prefix and no `orgs/`-prefixed writer remains.

findings.title: Realtime/SSE notification channel is scoped by user only, with no org assertion
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/notifications.ts:181-196 notificationInScope drops non-matching orgs, and :231,285,302-303 apply the resolved org to the stream and initial query; notifications-sse-scope.test.ts covers it.

findings.title: Platform-admin cross-tenant access is role-key based, broad, and unalerted
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: the role-key split narrows the tier; cross-tenant entries are written to impersonation_log (services/impersonation.ts) and incremented in lib/metrics.ts:137-140 with Prometheus alerts MCTImpersonationBurst/MCTImpersonationActivity (prometheus.rules.yml:102-120). Residual unchanged: the audit write is still fire-and-forget (void logImpersonation in middleware/org-access.ts:52,197 and lib/tenant.ts:48), so an insert failure drops the record, and the metric carries no organization label.

findings.title: Platform-wide report generators run as service role with no tenant guard on scope inputs
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: scheduled report generators derive the org from the DB row and scope every read - worker/tasks/module-tasks.ts qbrScheduledGenerate (:1062-1124) and saas-audit-scan (:1300-1345) use `.eq('organization_id', orgId)`; api/lib/task-producer.ts:76-104 refuses scheduled-only tasks and fails closed on queue-backend mismatch.

findings.title: Client-portal entitlement routes order requireAdmin before requireOrgAccess, bypassing the org-pinned admin check
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/client-portal.ts:121,145 order requireOrgAccess before requireAdmin on both entitlement routes, so the org-pinned admin check applies; client-portal-entitlements-org-pin.test.ts covers it.

findings.title: Platform-wide store intake and analytics endpoints are readable by any tenant admin with no cross-tenant gate
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/store/quotes.ts:36-37 requirePlatformAdmin (allTenants) on platform surfaces and :216-224 applies applyOrgScope on the quote list; analytics.ts:78-110 gates admin reads on allTenants; store-tenant-isolation.test.ts covers it.

findings.title: No automated cross-tenant isolation regression suite for application-layer scoping
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: isolation coverage includes tenant-scoping-guard.test.ts, search-tenant-scope, store-tenant-isolation, notifications-sse-scope, admin-scope-resolved-org, client-portal-entitlements-org-pin and final-view-gates. Residual unchanged: the static guard's KNOWN_UNSCOPED allowlist still lists 11 unremediated modules (tenant-scoping-guard.test.ts:49-64), and there is no per-module org-A->org-B matrix test.

findings.title: Admin notification create accepts an arbitrary recipient and org-less rows bypass the SSE scope assertion
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/notifications.ts:449-470 admin create requires requireAdmin plus assertSharesActiveOrg on the recipient and assertOrgScopeMatches on a supplied org, and stamps the resolved org; list/SSE paths apply applyResolvedOrg.

findings.title: A cross-tenant admin membership widens admin scope to orgs where the user is only a client/member
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a5: requireOrgAccess treats any approved cross-tenant role as org-agnostic and leaves req.orgId null when no active/query org is supplied (middleware/org-access.ts:140-146). requireAdmin only pins the request when orgScope.explicit is true (middleware/admin.ts:49-58), and resolveAdminTenantScope then builds orgIds from EVERY approved membership (lib/admin-scope.ts:63-74), not only admin orgs. A user who is `admin` in org A and `client_user` in org B therefore passes requireAdmin with no explicit org and gets orgIds=[A,B]; audit list/export (routes/audit.ts:28-37), dashboard/business-os aggregates, global search (routes/search.ts:80-108) and tickets bulk (routes/tickets.ts:613-623) all operate on B as well. Reproduce by omitting ?organization_id and the mct_active_org cookie for such a two-org user.
